purpose: Define AccessCore activation from explicit instance configuration, reload/login behavior and the rule that active AC cannot be disabled through ordinary runtime mutation.

topics.name: AccessCore Activation
topics.purpose: Define AccessCore activation from explicit instance configuration, reload/login behavior and the rule that active AC cannot be disabled through ordinary runtime mutation.

semantics.activation_rule: AC activation is explicit configuration, not inferred from presence of policy files.
semantics.login_rule: Reload/activation enters the configured authentication flow before governed runtime access.
semantics.disable_rule: When AC is active, ordinary runtime operations cannot disable it; disabling requires an explicit permitted configuration/restart path owned by the configuration authority.
semantics.state_rule: Configured AC enablement and current authenticated session state are separate.
semantics.projection_rule: Editors may edit canonical config only through authorized configuration operations.

invariants.rule: Identity assurance, authorization, remote delegation and activation state remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: AC activation inferred from policy-file presence
active AC disabled through ordinary runtime command without permitted config authority
authenticated session state conflated with configured enablement
Editor bypasses authorization to change AC config
#AC mount treated as separate authority source

references.purpose: AC activation participates in explicit runtime configuration.
